quotes.text: Use the standalone 3DS API to run EMV 3D Secure authentication independently from payment authorization.
Access the full 3DS protocol output, including the authentication result, Electronic Commerce Indicator (ECI), Directory Server (DS) Transaction ID, and the cryptogram.
Use 3DS Requestor Initiated (3RI) authentication for transactions where the cardholder isn’t present
When authenticated, submit the cryptogram as part of a payment authorization request.
Stripe supports the 3DS protocol up to and including version 2.3.1.

old_evidence.text: The successful completion of a standalone 3DS authentication results in a 3DS cryptogram, which you might submit as part of a payment authorization request
It’s available to businesses on Interchange Plus pricing and in all countries where Stripe supports card payments, with the exception of Malaysia and Thailand.

findings: The November same-URL guide expands the former thin overview into feature and workflow detail. It documents frictionless, challenge, and data-share-only request modes and issuer result/ECI/DS Transaction ID/cryptogram output (new raw:13-15); recurring/installment/card-on-file and 3RI with previous-authentication reference (new raw:17); non-payment authentication (new raw:19); and platform use for connected accounts (new raw:21). Add the new capture to the source and give these new topics bounded locators.

The November sequence creates a 3DS Authentication object, optionally fingerprints if the issuer supports it, submits via DS/ACS, challenges if required with completion webhook, then retrieves the outcome (new raw:25-31). Its success path passes the cryptogram to a separate payment authorization request, either with Stripe import or another PSP (new raw:33). Neither successful 3DS authentication nor a cryptogram proves authorization, capture, settlement, issuer payment approval, or a liability-shift result. The old guide already made authentication and authorization separate (old raw:8,18-22).

The November page names Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Cartes Bancaires; says availability covers Stripe card-payment countries except Malaysia and Thailand; and states Stripe supports the 3DS protocol through version 2.3.1 (new raw:35-39). Geographic product availability does not establish any account's entitlement or successful integration.

The old guide expressly said available to businesses on Interchange Plus pricing (old raw:24), while the November guide omits pricing eligibility (new raw:35-43). Do not infer removal of the prior condition or universal account eligibility. Current source line 19, Stripe index line 463, and stripe-3d-secure concept lines 131 and 159 say 'IC+ only'; the old raw supports an Interchange Plus availability statement but not the stronger exclusivity word 'only'. Rephrase as a dated May-capture qualification with current pricing eligibility unresolved.

Current source lines 13-21 and concept lines 125-131 cover the old thin overview. Expand the source for new November details; keep concept edits limited to the important authentication/authorization boundary, dated eligibility qualification, and a source route for details. Do not transfer the separate 3DS result-import availability matrix in concept lines 113-123 to standalone 3DS.
substantive_changes: Expanded same-URL guide now specifies request modes, 3DS protocol output, 3RI and other scenarios, non-payment authentication, and Connect platform use (new raw:13-21 versus old raw:10-16).
New five-step authentication workflow, with issuer-conditional optional fingerprinting, conditional challenge, completion webhook, and separate subsequent payment authorization (new raw:25-33).
New protocol-version ceiling of 2.3.1 (new raw:39). The Interchange Plus pricing sentence present at old raw:24 is omitted; its absence is not an established entitlement change.
historical_claims_to_preserve: The May capture stated availability to businesses on Interchange Plus pricing and excluded Malaysia and Thailand from the Stripe card-payment-country footprint (old raw:24). Preserve that as dated history; do not claim it was rescinded or that IC+ was the exclusive tier.

The old capture described an authentication cryptogram that might be submitted for payment authorization through Stripe import or another PSP (old raw:18-22). Keep the authentication/payment distinction.
conflicts: Source line 19, Stripe index line 463, and stripe-3d-secure concept lines 131 and 159 say 'IC+ only', whereas old raw:24 says available to Interchange Plus businesses without the word 'only' and new raw:35-43 omits pricing entirely. Their unqualified exclusivity/current-eligibility wording exceeds the pinned evidence.
unresolved_questions: Current pricing-tier and account eligibility for standalone 3DS cannot be resolved from the new capture's omission of the old Interchange Plus sentence; contact/account-specific criteria remain unverified.
The guide states protocol support through 2.3.1 but does not establish that every issuer, network, account, or transaction supports every request mode or protocol version.

answers.Q1: The November capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/3d-secure/standalone-3d-secure materially expands the prior overview: new raw:13-21 describes request modes, protocol signals, 3RI, non-payment use, and Connect, while new raw:25-33 gives the issuer authentication sequence and separate later authorization. The old capture at old raw:8,18-22 already distinguished authentication from payment authorization. [[source-stripe-standalone-3ds]] needs new raw provenance and bounded detail, including the version-2.3.1 statement at new raw:39.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/3d-secure/standalone-3d-secure, preserve the May guide's Interchange Plus availability wording as dated evidence at old raw:24, and avoid the current [[source-stripe-standalone-3ds]] line 19 claim of 'IC+ only'. The November guide omits pricing eligibility at new raw:35-43 but retains geographic exclusions and adds protocol support through 2.3.1 at new raw:37-39. A successful authentication yields a cryptogram for a separate authorization request at new raw:31-33; it is not payment completion.
